title: Living systematic review to VOI and bias-transport handoff for tobac
claim_boundary: Source-verified specification and granular execution playbook only; living-review-to-VOI delta export and PICO transportability weighting remain open implementation gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

Enforce sub-document byte-span digest and Sourceright/CiteWeft provenance binding on every exported effect estimate in crates/searchright-provenance/src/lib.rs.
Add golden tobacco/vaping policy evidence transport fixtures and negative ungrounded-effect rejection tests for tobac and voiage.
